name: RELEASE-FLOW-the-account-deploy-out-of-the-environment

name: RELEASE-FLOW-a-workflow-environment-undeclared

name: RELEASE-FLOW-check-off-main

name: ROLES-a-squash-into-release

name: HOTFIX-BACK-release-forced-over-an-open-branch

note: A conflict would be settled by taking release's side, unseen.

name: CHECK-ASK-the-default-branch-checked

note: The refusals go through GraphQL's addComment, which a pull request refuses a token without pull-requests: write - the job holds issues: write, so a reader asking /check would be told nothing and the run would fail.
